protocol.purpose: Exploratory ECGData.mat evaluation of four-mode EMD/Hilbert rotational morphology descriptors
protocol.source_method: Alavi et al., medRxiv 2026, DOI 10.64898/2026.07.08.26357521; independent adaptation, not a verified reproduction

data.outer_folds: reuse exact five patient folds in attention method/features/ecgdata_lfcc_v1

windows.selection: uniform without replacement from complete non-overlapping 30-second grid windows
windows.preprocessing_fit: none; each window is independently standardized before EMD

emd.failure: retain terminal failure; no automatic cap increase, replacement, or silent exclusion

analytic.frequency: unwrap phase and differentiate with numpy.gradient at dt=1/fs, edge_order=2; signed Hz without clipping
analytic.global_frequency: instantaneous energy-weighted frequency, then time mean
analytic.global_envelope: instantaneous root-sum-square envelope, then time mean
analytic.geometry: exact arc-length centroid of the open piecewise-linear path formed by summing four trimmed analytic components

evaluation.patient_vote: sum out-of-fold probabilities across the 10 sampled windows per patient lead row; choose highest averaged class probability; combine all lead rows for patient
evaluation.interval_scope: conditional on saved out-of-fold predictions; does not include retraining uncertainty
evaluation.failures: all attempted clips remain in the ledger; report primary complete-case metrics only when coverage and per-class failure counts are shown; do not replace failed clips

execution.extraction_executor: separate processes; thread-based EMD was stopped before producing outputs
execution.resume: verify content identity and reuse terminal successes and failures; unfinished clips only
execution.validation_and_test: all five patient folds are outer evaluation folds; no external data or patients
execution.source_hashes_and_environment: record before extraction and model fitting

limitations: ECGData has only 80 patients and diagnosis is confounded with source database.
Each 30-second window is independently z-scored, so centroid and envelope amplitudes are in standardized signal units rather than calibrated mV.
This three-class ARR/CHF/NSR experiment is not an MI or OMI diagnostic evaluation.
Results are not directly comparable to the prior LFCC Swin score because window duration and representation differ.
